diabolo_scene_mjcf — DRIVE diabolo op

• Data kinds: table → any

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.diabolo_scene_mjcf(params: 'dict', *, timestep: 'float' = 0.00025, solref=(0.0005, 1.0), wrap_axle: 'bool' = False) -> 'str' (to call the implementation directly, import diabolo; diabolo.diabolo_scene_mjcf(params: 'dict', *, timestep: 'float' = 0.00025, solref=(0.0005, 1.0), wrap_axle: 'bool' = False) -> 'str'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("diabolo_scene_mjcf"))

Usage

MJCF string of the second (independent) implementation's scene (mujoco not required): spatial tendon stick tip → diabolo → stick tip with length limit = string (a one-sided constraint = pulls only when stretched, i.e. the same physics as the exact frictionless-pulley model, solved by a different method: soft constraints and implicit velocity updates). The stick tips are mocap (positions written each step). The diabolo is a free-joint rigid body (mass = Table I of the paper, inertia assumed; rotation is not coupled to the string). If wrap_axle = True, the tendon wraps around the axle cylinder (radius r) (passing underneath, unverified). Raises ValueError: params shape, timestep ≤ 0, solref is not 2 positive numbers.
